input.quote: 18.14 Counterparts; Other Matters. This Agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument.
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns only incidental references in the definitions (freight/insurance costs in Net Sales and health insurance payers), and neither Article XVI (Indemnification; Recalls) nor Article XVIII (General Provisions, ending at 18.14) contains any insurance covenant. Array is the licensor and also manufactures and supplies Product and sponsors Clinical Studies, and it gives product-liability and recall indemnities to Ono under Section 16.2, so uninsured indemnity cover is a real credit risk to us. No usable clause exists anywhere, so this is a missing finding rather than a fallback. We propose a short new Section 18.15 in General Provisions imposing the preferred limits on Array only (no reciprocal obligation on Ono), adapted to a pharma licence by adding products/clinical trial liability and making cyber cover conditional on Array handling our data. Note the parties are also to execute a separate Supply Agreement and Quality Agreement (Section 18.7), which may carry manufacturing insurance; if so the limits here can be aligned rather than duplicated. Severity is low.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 18.15 requiring Array to carry general/products, professional and cyber liability insurance with certificates on request
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance covenant, so we have added a short Section 18.15 requiring Array to carry commercial general liability (including products and clinical trial liability), professional liability and, where it handles our confidential or personal data, cyber cover, with certificates on request. This backs up Array's indemnity and recall obligations under Article 16; we can discuss reduced limits (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) if the stated amounts exceed Array's current programme.

ops.text: 18.15 Insurance. Array shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the Term and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance (including products liability and, in respect of any Clinical Studies conducted by or on behalf of Array, clinical trial liability) of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) to the extent Array processes any personal data or other Confidential Information of Ono, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Array shall provide Ono with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
